This overlap is material rather than merely generic proclamation boilerplate.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I also direct the appropriate officials of the Government to arrange for the display of the flag of the United States on all public buildings on Armistice Day.","parent_excerpt":"do hereby direct the appropriate officials of the Government to arrange for the display of the flag of the United States on all public buildings on Mother's Day, May 13, 1951","explanation":"The operative sentence uses substantially identical actors, command, arrangement mechanism, object, location, and commemorative-day adaptation."},{"child_excerpt":"do hereby call upon the people of the Nation to observe Tuesday, November 11, 1952","parent_excerpt":"I call upon the people to display the flag on that day at their homes or other suitable places as a public expression of honor for our mothers.","explanation":"Both pair the official flag-display direction with a public commemorative appeal, although the requested public conduct differs."}]}
